svg.title: Conclusion / תולדה
svg.desc: Chapter 7, Hebrew p93, English p94. A downward arrow emerges from a dotted horizontal boundary above it and arrives at an outlined, lightly tinted teal statement unit. The dots represent the prior reasoning from which this conclusion emerges. It marks the statement derived in this deduction. The outline denotes the derived role, not uncertainty. A conclusion is not the causal Result badge, a final verdict, or a requirement that every argument have only one premise.
